findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "token_trending" is 2665 chars, far longer than this server's median (336). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_gpu_comps · Private data: ping, wallet_preview, token_check_demo, wallet_profile, token_trending, wallet_funding, wallet_quick, wallet_quick_batch, payee_check, pretrade, preview_document, extract_document · Public sink: token_trending, wallet_funding, price_note.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_gpu_comps · Private data: ping, wallet_preview, token_check_demo, wallet_profile, token_trending, wallet_funding, wallet_quick, wallet_quick_batch, payee_check, pretrade, preview_document, extract_document · Public sink: token_trending, wallet_funding, price_note

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
